dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a value of LocalDef003, this abbreviation is its third stored component, a predicate on real-valued functions on Ω.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied to LocalDef002 μ p and X, it exposes the representativeMember predicate stored in that package; hence the left side of the target equivalence is that membership predicate applied to X.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: This constructs a LocalDef003 package whose representative norm is eLpNorm at exponent p and measure μ, whose representative membership predicate is MeasureTheory.MemLp at p and μ, and whose quotient component is MeasureTheory.Lp Real p μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its representativeMember field specializes the left side of the equivalence to MeasureTheory.MemLp X p μ; its other stored fields are not selected by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A package type, indexed by a measure μ and exponent p, that stores a representative norm, a representative-membership predicate, an Lp quotient, and certificates relating these components to the corresponding MeasureTheory notions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target uses a value of this package only through the third projection selected by LocalDef001, namely its representative-membership predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for LocalDef003: it accepts a function norm, a proof that it equals eLpNorm, a membership predicate, a proof that it is equivalent to MemLp, a quotient additive subgroup, and a proof that it equals MeasureTheory.Lp.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains the fields populated by LocalDef002. Only the supplied representativeMember component can reach the target through LocalDef001; the constructor's other components and certificates do not add hypotheses to the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every μ, p, and real-valued x, this theorem proves the reflexive equality eLpNorm x p μ = eLpNorm x p μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It can fill LocalDef002's representativeNorm equality certificate but contributes no mathematical restriction and is not part of the target proposition after the representativeMember field is selected.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every μ, p, and real-valued x, this theorem proves the reflexive equivalence MemLp x p μ ↔ MemLp x p μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It certifies that LocalDef002's chosen representativeMember predicate is MemLp; the certificate is tautological and adds no condition to the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: For every μ and p, this theorem proves the reflexive equality MeasureTheory.Lp Real p μ = MeasureTheory.Lp Real p μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It can fill the quotient equality certificate in LocalDef002, but that quotient field is not selected in the target, so this dependency has no substantive effect on the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousENorm.toENorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: This abbreviation extracts the underlying extended-valued norm structure ENorm from a ContinuousENorm structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the ENorm instance on Real used when forming eLpNorm; it changes no quantifier or logical condition.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, implemented as nonnegative real numbers with an added top element ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The exponent p and the value of eLpNorm lie in this type, so p may be finite or ∞ and norm finiteness is expressed by strict inequality from the top element.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.instPartialOrder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The partial-order structure on ENNReal inherited from the order on nonnegative reals with a top element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the strict comparison eLpNorm X p μ < ∞ on the right side of the equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: Iff
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical equivalence of two propositions: each proposition implies the other.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires representative membership and finiteness of eLpNorm to be equivalent, not merely related in one direction.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-less-than relation furnished by an LT structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the ENNReal order instance, it expresses that eLpNorm X p μ is strictly below top, i.e. finite.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: A measurable-space structure on Ω, supplying the collection of measurable subsets used by measures and measurability notions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It equips the arbitrary type Ω with measurable structure and thereby fixes the domain on which μ, a.e. strong measurability, MemLp, and eLpNorm are interpreted.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function f is almost-everywhere strongly measurable with respect to μ when there exists a strongly measurable function g that equals f μ-almost everywhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is assumed explicitly for X, and it is also the first conjunct in MemLp. The explicit hypothesis discharges that conjunct, leaving MemLp equivalent to finiteness of eLpNorm.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proposition/typeclass asserting that μ is a probability measure on the given measurable space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It restricts μ to probability measures. The displayed reduction of MemLp to measurability plus finite eLpNorm does not otherwise use probability normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Measure
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of measures on a type equipped with a measurable-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified μ supplies the measure used for almost-everywhere equality, a.e. strong measurability, MemLp, and eLpNorm.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended Lp seminorm: it is 0 when p = 0, the essential-supremum norm when p = ∞, and eLpNorm' with real exponent p.toReal otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its value is the representative norm and the quantity required to be strictly below ∞. Because p ≠ 0, the p = 0 branch is excluded, while the p = ∞ branch remains allowed.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality a ≠ b, defined as the negation of equality a = b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It states the hypothesis p ≠ 0, excluding only the zero ENNReal exponent.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection that forgets commutativity from a nonunital seminormed commutative ring, retaining its nonunital seminormed-ring structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates only in the inferred norm/topological structure on Real needed by eLpNorm and a.e. strong measurability; it adds no proposition-level condition.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection/constructor that retains the seminormed additive commutative-group structure underlying a nonunital seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the instance chain providing Real's norm and topology; it has no independent logical effect on the target.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection/constructor that views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It helps derive the ENorm and topology on Real used by eLpNorm and measurability, without adding a mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The interpretation of a natural-number literal in a type carrying the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the ENNReal zero instance, it interprets the literal 0 in the hypothesis p ≠ 0.

dependency_coverage.name: PartialOrder.toPreorder
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a partial order to its underlying preorder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an instance-coercion step used to obtain ENNReal's strict order; it does not alter the finiteness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Preorder.toLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a preorder to its strict-less-than operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the less-than relation used in eLpNorm X p μ < ∞ and adds no separate assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a pseudometric-space structure to its induced uniform-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is part of the construction of Real's topology for a.e. strong measurability and ENorm continuity; it has no independent logical content in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the codomain of X and the scalar/function type used in MemLp, eLpNorm, and the stored Lp quotient.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed commutative-ring structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies Real's normed algebraic structure, from which the ENorm and topology required by eLpNorm and measurability are derived; it introduces no extra hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard pseudometric-space structure on Real, with distance induced by absolute difference.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its induced topology is used in the a.e.-strong-measurability predicate on X; it does not change the target's logical form.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection/constructor that forgets commutativity from a seminormed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is another instance-chain step used to obtain Real's continuous extended norm and topology, with no independent proposition-level effect.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddGroup.toContinuousENorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: A seminormed additive group carries a continuous extended-valued norm, obtained here from its nonnegative norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the ContinuousENorm, hence ENorm, instance on Real required by eLpNorm; it contributes no hypothesis or conclusion of its own.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedAddGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a seminormed additive group to its underlying pseudometric-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies part of Real's metric/topological instance chain and has no independent mathematical effect on the equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structure projection/constructor that forgets the unit from a seminormed commutative ring while retaining its seminormed commutative-ring operations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used only in deriving Real's seminormed additive and continuous-ENorm structures; it adds no target-level condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Top.top
dependency_coverage.meaning: The distinguished greatest element of a type carrying a Top structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For ENNReal it denotes ∞, so strict inequality against this value is precisely the displayed norm-finiteness condition.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection from a uniform-space structure to its induced topological-space structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the standard topology on Real used in AEStronglyMeasurable and MemLp; it does not add a logical restriction.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: A Zero structure supplies the interpretation of the natural-number literal 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies the 0 appearing in p ≠ 0 with the zero element of ENNReal.

dependency_coverage.name: instTopENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Top instance on ENNReal, whose top element is the added WithTop value ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the right-hand bound in eLpNorm X p μ < ∞ and also the p = ∞ branch in the definition of eLpNorm.

dependency_coverage.name: instZeroENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Zero instance on ENNReal, inherited as the zero nonnegative real in WithTop NNReal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the zero excluded by the hypothesis p ≠ 0 and the output of eLpNorm's p = 0 branch.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Lp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive subgroup of almost-everywhere equivalence classes of functions whose cast representative has eLpNorm strictly below ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: LocalDef002 stores this subgroup as its quotient component, but LocalDef001 selects the representativeMember field instead, so the target asserts nothing directly about quotient elements or additive-subgroup structure.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.MemLp
dependency_coverage.meaning: MemLp f p μ is the conjunction that f is a.e. strongly measurable with respect to μ and that eLpNorm f p μ is strictly below ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is exactly the representativeMember predicate on the left. Under the explicit hypothesis that X is a.e. strongly measurable, the target becomes (true-and-finite-norm) ↔ finite-norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed additive commutative-group structure on Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the normed additive structure needed for the real-valued Lp constructions and stored quotient; it adds no explicit condition to the target.

dependency_coverage.name: AddSubgroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: A subset of an additive group that contains zero and is closed under addition and additive inverses, packaged with those closure properties.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the quotient component stored in LocalDef003/LocalDef002, but that component is not selected by the target and therefore does not affect the equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality between two terms of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Equality appears in the package certificates and in the definitions of ≠ and eLpNorm's case splits; no nontrivial equality is asserted by the target's conclusion itself.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.AEEqFun
dependency_coverage.meaning: The quotient of functions by the setoid of equality μ-almost everywhere.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the ambient additive-group type for the stored MeasureTheory.Lp subgroup. Since the target concerns an ordinary representative X and selects only representativeMember, the quotient has no direct role in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.AEEqFun.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-group structure on almost-everywhere equivalence classes, induced from pointwise addition and negation on representatives.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables AddSubgroup in the definition of MeasureTheory.Lp but does not affect the selected representative-membership predicate or norm-finiteness equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard additive-group structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies pointwise addition for AEEqFun and the stored Lp additive subgroup, neither of which contributes an extra condition to the target equivalence.

dependency_coverage.name: instIsTopologicalAddGroupReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard fact/instance that addition and negation on Real are continuous, making Real a topological additive group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is needed to induce the additive-group structure on real-valued AEEqFun objects used by MeasureTheory.Lp; the target selects no quotient operation, so it has no direct logical effect.

binders: An arbitrary type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A measure μ on Ω, together with an instance asserting that μ is a probability measure.
A real-valued function X : Ω → ℝ.
A hypothesis hX that X is a.e. strongly measurable with respect to μ.
hypotheses: μ is restricted to be a probability measure.
p is not the zero element of ENNReal; p may nevertheless equal ∞.
X is a.e. strongly measurable with respect to μ, meaning it has a strongly measurable version equal to it μ-almost everywhere.
conclusions: The representative-membership predicate stored by LocalDef002 μ p holds for X if and only if eLpNorm X p μ is finite, i.e. eLpNorm X p μ < ∞.
After expanding LocalDef002 and MemLp, the conclusion is (AEStronglyMeasurable X μ ∧ eLpNorm X p μ < ∞) ↔ (eLpNorm X p μ < ∞); the assumed a.e. strong measurability supplies the first conjunct.
mathematical_definitions: ENNReal is the extended nonnegative real line [0, ∞], including a greatest element ∞.
eLpNorm is 0 at p = 0, is the essential-supremum norm at p = ∞, and otherwise is the finite-exponent extended Lp seminorm formed using p.toReal.
LocalDef002 μ p packages eLpNorm as its representative norm, MemLp as its representative-membership predicate, and MeasureTheory.Lp Real p μ as its quotient component.
LocalDef001 selects the third component of that package, namely representativeMember.
MemLp X p μ means AEStronglyMeasurable X μ ∧ eLpNorm X p μ < ∞.
AEStronglyMeasurable X μ means that some strongly measurable function equals X μ-almost everywhere.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every probability measure μ on an arbitrary measurable space Ω, every nonzero extended nonnegative exponent p, and every a.e.-strongly-measurable real-valued function X on Ω, X satisfies the representative-membership predicate stored in the specified Lp package exactly when its extended Lp seminorm is finite. The stored predicate is MemLp, which by definition is the conjunction of a.e. strong measurability and finite eLpNorm, so under the stated measurability hypothesis the equivalence reduces to (hX ∧ eLpNorm X p μ < ∞) ↔ (eLpNorm X p μ < ∞).

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The measure is restricted to probability measures, although that restriction is not used in the displayed definitional reduction of the conclusion; the statement does not quantify over arbitrary measures.
The exponent ranges over ENNReal and is only required to be nonzero. In particular, no assumption p ≥ 1 or p < ∞ is present, and p = ∞ is included.
At p = ∞, eLpNorm uses the essential-supremum branch, and eLpNorm X p μ < ∞ is an essential-boundedness condition.
The function is restricted to real-valued functions that are already a.e. strongly measurable. There is no conclusion for a function lacking that hypothesis.

Because a.e. strong measurability is both assumed and built into MemLp, the asserted equivalence is driven by the hypothesis and the definition of MemLp; it does not characterize measurability from norm finiteness alone.

The conclusion is about a concrete representative X. Although the package stores an Lp additive subgroup of almost-everywhere equivalence classes, the target asserts no property of quotient elements, equality classes, completeness, or vector-space structure.
The condition eLpNorm X p μ < ∞ is specifically strict inequality below ENNReal top; it is not an assertion that the seminorm is positive or nonzero.
The hypothesis p ≠ 0 excludes eLpNorm's forced-zero branch, but it is not needed for the purely logical simplification of MemLp under the explicit measurability hypothesis as displayed.
